top_signals.title: Anthropic (ANT) IPO on Nasdaq Overcame AI Fears and Warnings
top_signals.summary: The pioneering AI lab saw unprecedented demand for its stock from both retail and institutional investors.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Frasers CFO Unleashes on Accent as Australian Bid Turns Personal
top_signals.summary: Frasers Group Plc’s pursuit of Australia’s Accent Group Ltd. turned personal after Frasers’ finance chief flew to the retailer’s annual meeting in Melbourne to publicly accuse it of under-performance and demand the chairman quit.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
